description: This file defines the 'JsonBody' class responsible for formatting the JSON body of JSON-REST or JSON-RPC API operations within the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes methods to determine content type and build JSON payloads based on shape objects.

classes.name: JsonBody
classes.description: A class responsible for formatting the JSON body for AWS API requests, tailored for different payload shapes and protocol-specific content types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the JsonBody instance with an API service object.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Static method that returns the appropriate Content-Type header based on the service protocol and JSON version.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates a JSON string payload from the shape and arguments, encoding the formatted shape data.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Recursively formats the shape and value into a JSON-compatible array or object, handling structures, lists, maps, blobs, and timestamps.
